title: Financial Aid Summary for New Admits (USC Undergraduate)
text:
Note: estimates on this page use the 2026-2027 academic year cost of attendance. Revised and Regular Decision summaries cover 2027-2028.

APPLICATION AND REVIEW
- The review is complete once a FAFSA or CADAA, the CSS Profile, and supporting documentation have been received and reviewed.
- Track your status in the USC Financial Aid Summary and Tasks (FAST) portal.
- Until you certify enrollment (by submitting the Statement of Intent form and/or Enrollment Commitment), notices go to the email on your admission application. After that, they go to your USC email.
- You will be notified by email after your file is complete.

WHAT AID IS OFFERED
- Your summary shows eligibility for federal, state, and university aid.
- Most students receive a mix of grants, loans, and Federal Work-Study.
- If you missed one or more deadlines, your eligibility may be limited to Federal Direct Loans.

SUMMARY TIMING
- Estimated summaries are released based on the date you applied for aid, using the 2026-2027 cost of attendance, and are marked with an "estimate" watermark.
- Early Decision: estimated summary released in December.
- Early Action: estimated summary released in February.
- Revised summaries for ED and EA applicants use the 2027-2028 cost of attendance and do not carry the estimate watermark.
- Regular Decision: no estimate is issued; summaries are released on or before April 1, based on the 2027-2028 cost of attendance.
- Later changes are viewable online only.

SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES
- If your family's income or expenses change unexpectedly and you want a re-evaluation, use the Special Circumstances and Appeals page.

CONTACTS
- Phone: 213-740-2311 (University Park Campus)
- Help & Contact: financialaid.usc.edu/help-contact/
